search_log: Listed every filing for CIK 1131399 (GSK plc) from data.sec.gov/submissions including the older 'files' pages. Results announcements selected as 6-Ks filed from 2020-07 with total size > 1 MB on the results dates (2020-07-29 ... 2026-10-28; from 2025 GSK furnishes > 1 MB buy-back 6-Ks daily, so results filings were picked by filing date and confirmed by content: each picked document prints the 'Total / US / Europe / International' turnover tables).

Product rows taken from the turnover-by-product tables whose header reads 'Total US Europe International' (columns £m, AER%, CER% per region; '£m' printed in the table's own header rows). Each table's caption ('Pharmaceuticals turnover – three months ended 30 September 2020', 'Specialty Medicines turnover – six months ended 30 June 2022', ...) decides quarter vs year-to-date; only 'three months ended' tables are used for quarters. A printed dash in the Total column is a nil (0). Quarters were summed against the six-month, nine-month and full-year tables of the same releases.
Momelotinib came to GSK with Sierra Oncology (acquired 2022) before any approval, so there are no pre-GSK sales. Row label 'Ojjaara' (2023Q3-2024Q1), 'Ojjaara/Omjjara' (EU brand) from 2024Q2.
